stem: An analyst divides the deals Voltmarkt's business sales team won in Q3, counted by close date, by the opportunities created in Q3. Which problem does this cause?

options.text: None, as long as both of the counts use the very same quarter
The counts cover different deals, so the rate can exceed 100%
It counts the open deals as won, so the rate is too high
It only matters for deals worth more than the average deal size
